# Incident Triage & RCA

Open from an incident and see **correlated evidence for root-cause analysis**: blast radius, a unified change/alert/telemetry timeline, agent-ranked root-cause candidates with confidence and missing data, and a recommended, reversible remediation.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

parameters.name: LogAnalyticsWorkspaceId
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace
parameters.query: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces' | project value = id, label = name, selected = false | order by label asc

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.label: Environment

parameters.label: Business criticality

content.json:
## Incident posture at a glance

Live incident pressure: fired alerts and the recent change load that is the leading root-cause candidate.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition)
| where cond == 'Fired'
| summarize Crit = countif(sev in ('Sev0','Sev1')), Warn = countif(sev in ('Sev2','Sev3')), Total = count()
| extend Posture = case(Crit > 0, 'CRITICAL', Warn > 0, 'DEGRADED', Total > 0, 'ELEVATED', 'HEALTHY')
| project Posture, ['Active alerts'] = Total
content.title: Alert posture

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition)
| where cond == 'Fired'
| summarize Alerts = count() by Severity = sev
| order by Severity asc
content.title: Fired alerts by severity

content.query:
resourcechanges
| extend ct = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp)
| where ct > ago(24h)
| summarize Changes = count()
| extend Window = 'Last 24h'
| project Window, Changes
content.title: Resource changes (last 24h)

content.json:
## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "Incident Triage & RCA" and WorkbookPage == "Incident Triage & RCA"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

## Incident context

Set the incident/correlation identifiers to focus the evidence below. Leave blank to see tenant-wide active incidents.

## Incident summary

Severity, state, owner, affected workload, and business criticality for the selected incident. Bind your incident/ITSM source for full fidelity.

> **Placeholder - Incident record**
>
> Bind your incident table (ServiceNow/ADO/Incidents_CL) filtered by `{IncidentId}` to show severity, state, owner, affected workload, and business criticality.
>
> Supply the tenant-specific data source, then replace this tile with the documented query. See `docs/data-sources.md`.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| extend sev = tostring(properties.essentials.severity),
         cond = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition),
         rule = tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule),
         target = tostring(properties.essentials.targetResource),
         fired = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime)
| where cond == 'Fired'
| project fired, sev, rule, target
| order by fired desc
| take 50
content.title: Currently active alerts (triage candidates)

content.json:
## Blast radius

What is impacted: apps, regions, subscriptions, dependencies, user journeys, and SLOs. Quantifies how far the incident reaches.

content.query:
healthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/availabilitystatuses'
| extend state = tostring(properties.availabilityState)
| where state in ('Unavailable','Degraded')
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name) on subscriptionId
| summarize Impacted = count() by location, Subscription
| order by Impacted desc
content.title: Impacted resources by region (unhealthy)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Success == false
| summarize Failures = count() by Target, DependencyType
| order by Failures desc
| take 25
content.title: Impacted dependencies (failures in window)

content.json:
## Timeline

Unified timeline of control-plane changes (deployments, config, RBAC, policy, network) from Activity logs. Correlate change spikes with the alert onset.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Control-plane activity timeline

content.query:
resourcechanges
| extend changeType = tostring(properties.changeType),
         changeTime = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp),
         target = tostring(properties.targetResourceId)
| project changeTime, changeType, target
| order by changeTime desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent resource changes

content.json:
## Root cause candidates

Agent-ranked hypotheses with confidence, supporting evidence, what data is missing, and the suggested validation step. Review before approving remediation.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Category in ('Root cause','RCA')
| where isempty('{IncidentId}') or RelatedIncidentId == '{IncidentId}'
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| project ConfidenceScore, RecommendationText, Reason, EvidenceSummary, AffectedScope, EvidenceLinks
| order by ConfidenceScore desc
content.title: Agent root-cause candidates

content.json:
## Recommended remediation

The agent's proposed fix, its risk, whether rollback is available, and the approval requirement. **Remediation is always approval-gated.**

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where AgentActionType in ('Auto-remediate','Open PR','Open ticket','Request approval','Escalate')
| where isempty('{IncidentId}') or RelatedIncidentId == '{IncidentId}'
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| project Severity, RecommendationText, AgentActionType, ApprovalRequired, RemediationRisk, RollbackAvailable, Status, EvidenceLinks
| order by Severity asc
content.title: Recommended remediation actions

content.json: > **Approval & rollback.** Remediation requires human approval; the agent records `RollbackAvailable` and a rollback plan before any action. Approve via the Command Center *Pending approvals* tile.

Prior incidents with the same signature and the open post-incident action items the agent is tracking to closure.

content.json:
---
### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
